scope: Retrospective conditional ablation using a simulated protected copy of original wheel telemetry; not independent sensing, live authentication, physical truth or held-out confirmation
protected_copy: original unmodified wheel scalar plus u*(pose_index modulo2); no target/localization input, fitted noise, clipping or calibration; deterministic one-sided bounded perturbation avoids negative scalar speed
uncertainty_status: illustrative assumption, not estimated or certified; coordinated stress cases also fix u=0 and u=0.75, and all results are retained
negative_controls: last seven cases use the same coordinated reported-channel attack; missing/stale/+3compromise/+1underreported-bound apply to protected copy during [5,15)s; u0/u0.75apply throughout; unestablished evidence disables conditional admission throughout
candidate_attacks: reuse the complete frozen seven-scenario attack model; interval[5,15)seconds, +3bias, one-second replay and held-snapshot loss unchanged
eligibility: explicit research assumption true, finite nonnegative protected value, finite uncertainty0<=u<=0.5 and causal selected receipt age<=100000us inclusive
legacy_agreement: exact prior age_and_agreement decision; retain all prior failures
conditional_anchor_only: output eligible protected-copy center, otherwise abstain; required assumption-only baseline
conditional_bounded_candidate: if protected copy eligible and candidate finite/nonnegative/fresh and abs(candidate-center)+u<=0.5 inclusive, output candidate; otherwise output eligible center; abstain if no eligible protected copy
bound: if actual clean-wheel-to-center deviation<=u and eligibility assumptions hold, selected output differs from original clean wheel trace by at most0.5m/s; this is NOT an independent physical speed or localization-accuracy bound
evaluation_reference: original unmodified pose horizontal speed is used only for outcome metrics; never for new selection or protected-copy construction
diagnostics: count protected-bound and output-to-original-wheel bound violations without using those truth diagnostics to reject or choose outputs; epsilon1e-12is only for floating-point trace diagnostics
evidence: freeze native baseline and all imported/new source hashes before outcomes; keep every row/case and per-scene metrics; independent reconstruction before final combined report
